title: NotificationSubscriber
description: Represents a notification subscriber linking providers with consumers.

providerIdentity.description: Identity (e.g. DID) of the data provider.

providerConfig.description: Configuration payload required for outbound notifications.

consumerIdentity.description:
Identity (e.g. DID) of the consumer organisation receiving notifications.
Optional for backward compat with rows created before the field existed.

consumerConfig.description: Configuration payload required for outbound notifications.

role.description:
The role of the consumer in the supply chain ecosystem (e.g. "BorderAgency",
"LocationOperator"). Matches the value referenced by the ODRL `$.party.role`
JsonPath. When undefined, treated as "BorderAgency" for backwards compatibility.

schemaVersion.description:
Identifier of the outbound payload schema this subscriber expects (e.g. "aut.v2.1").
When undefined, the dispatching task picks its default.

dateModified.description: The date/time of when the resource was last modified.
